title: feat(app-shell): a Studio rail search that matches nothing names the query and offers to clear it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8CbVK4eWbzTwqdFcwRSZgVo)_
Fixes #26733

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 的数据、自动化、权限三个侧栏共用一个「搜索无结果」状态:写出搜不到的关键词,并给一个「清除搜索」按钮,点了清空搜索框、列表恢复。
- 为什么改:之前数据和权限侧栏搜不到时整列空白,看起来像加载失败;自动化侧栏有一句提示但没有退路。
- 风险与回滚:只动侧栏的显示,不改任何过滤或排序;回滚即 revert 本 PR,i18n 包只多一个文案键。
- 先看:`StudioRail.tsx`(新状态与 `matchCount` 判定),`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(三处侧栏只传匹配数;数据侧栏的过滤原样上提成常量),新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioRail.noMatches-26733.test.tsx`,预期 13 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `StudioRail` (shared by every Studio pillar) gains `search.matchCount`: how many rows the pillar's own filter left. When the query is non-blank, `matchCount` is 0 and the list was not empty before searching (`count !== 0`), the rail shows one state under the list: the existing `engine.list.emptyQuery` sentence naming the trimmed query, and a **Clear search** button that calls `search.onChange('')` and focuses the box again.
- Data rail: the object filter is hoisted, unchanged, into `shownObjects` so its length can be handed to the rail; Automations passes `shownFlows.length`; Access passes `filtered.length`. No rail filters or sorts differently.
- The Automations rail's own copy of the no-matches sentence is removed: the rail now says it, once, for all three.
- `@object-ui/i18n` `studio` namespace: new row `engine.studio.rail.clearSearch` (en "Clear search", zh "清除搜索"); patch changeset.
- A blank query, or an empty package, never shows the line: each pillar's existing empty sentence keeps speaking there.

## Why

A builder who mistyped a rail search saw an empty column on Data and Access and could not tell a failed load from no matches (card #26733, from the studio-qa-2026-10-27 batch).

## Tests

New `StudioRail.noMatches-26733.test.tsx` renders the real Data, Automations and Access pillars. Per rail: a query that matches nothing shows the state naming the query and no row; Clear search empties and focuses the box and restores every row; a matching query shows no state; an empty package keeps its own sentence with no no-matches line, with or without a query. Plus a zh case (the state's sentence and the button read in Chinese).

The 7 are every positive case (three rails times two, plus zh); the 6 green are the matching-query controls and the empty-package cases, as expected. </details>

## Acceptance notes

- Measured before the fix on `origin/main` 5ec398dc: Data and Access rendered nothing under a non-matching query; Automations already printed `engine.list.emptyQuery` but had no clear action. The card's premise holds for Data and Access and half-holds for Automations.
- The sentence reuses the existing `engine.list.emptyQuery` row (straight quotes around the query), so no new sentence row was added and the existing Automations pin still reads the same text.
